Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL3880. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter assays.assay_organism equals 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3880'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
